translation.name: Las Escrituras en Ashéninka Ucayali del Sur del Perú

content: Ikanta iñaawakiri Jacob ipokaki rirentzi Esaú ramaki 400 ratzirite, rinashitanakanawo otomipaeni Lea, ashi Raquel, ashipaeni romperatane.
Rootaki reewataki apite romperatane itsipataakiro otomipaeni, opoñaapaaka Lea otsipatakari otomipaeni, roo impoetapaentsiri Raquel otsipatakari otomipaeni José.
Anashitanaka Jacob, ri jewataneentsiri. Okaatzi 7 rapiitakiro rotziwerowanaka rokaakitapaakira Esaú rirentzi, tema antawoete ipinkathatakiri oeyootapaaka.
Riitaki kantacha Esaú, ishiyashitawaari rirori, rawithakitapaakiri, inintawaeri. Apitepaeni rirahaeyanakani.
ari raminanakiro Esaú tsinanipaeni, eejatzi eentsipaeni, rojampitziri: “¿Iitaka irikapaeni?” Ikantzi Jacob: “Riitaki itomipaeni ponampiri ipakiriri Tajorentsi.”
Ari opokapaaki romperatanepaeni otsipatapaakari otomipaeni, otziwerowashitapaakari, antawoete opinkathatapaakiri oeyootapaaka kepatsiki.
Okanta opokapaaki eejatzi Lea otsipatapaakari otomipaeni, roojatzi antapaakiri roori. Riitaki weyaantapaakawori ipokapaaki José itsipatapaakawo riniro Raquel, iñaapinkathatapaakiri eejatzi.
Ari rojampitanakiri Esaú rirentzi Jacob, ikantziri: “¿jempe pikanterika pipirapaeni ikaatzi noñaawakiri?” Ikantanaki Jacob: “Riitaki pashi eeroka paakameethatantenari.”
Ikantanaki Esaú: “¡Eero yeeyi! Eenitatsi osheki nashi. Poejokirotyaari ikaatzi pashitari eeroka.”

Eekiro ishintsitanakitzi Jacob, ikantziri rirentzi: “¡Eero yeeyi! Tema noñaakiro paakameethatawakina, otzimatye payeri nopashitzimiri. Tema noñaapakimira piwathaki eeroka, oshiyawitakawo riimi Tajorentsi noñaaki. Tema kameethari pikanta piwethatawakina.

Rootaki nokowantari payero okaatzi namakimiri nopashitemiri, tema Tajorentsi ashaakantakahaanari, tekatsi koetyiimotenani.” Ikanta ishintsinetakiri Jacob rirentzi, roetsinampaakiri Esaú rayero okaatzi ipashitariri.
Ikantanaki Esaú: “Thame aate ajeeke jaka. Naaka jewatanakimini.”

Ikantzi Jacob: “Piyotzi eeroka yeeyi teera ishenkaashiwaeta eenchaanikipaeni. Otzimatye nokenkithashiretakoteri eejatzi nopirapaeni tzimayitatsiri iryaani. Arika nanashitakaanakiri apaani kitejeri, aritaki ikamayitaki.
Rootaki kameethatatsi peewatakahaeri pomperatane, eentsikiroenira nonoshikakaeyaari nopirapaeni, neentsitepaeni, roojatzi notsipatantapakimiri janta Seir-ki.”
Ikantzi Esaú: “Iriwé, nokoyi nopanakimi natzirite itsipatemi.” Ari ikantanaki Jacob: “Tee nokoyi, eero poñaashirenkana.”
Tee imaapaentzi Esaú intsipaete ipiyitanaka inampiki Seir-ki.
Riima Jacob, jataki rirori janta Sucot-ki. Ari rowetsikapaakiri ipanko, ipankoshetatapaakiri eejatzi ipirapaeni. Rootaki iitantakawori janta Sucot.
Tema ipoñahaawo Jacob janta Padan-aram-ki, tekatsi awijimoterini, kameetha rareeta janta Canaán-ki. Imontetapaawo inampikira Siquem ari rowetsikapaki rirori inampi.
Ramanantapakiro iipatsite itomipaeni Hamor, okaatzi opinatari 100 koriki. Irika Siquem riira itomi Hamor. Ari rowatzikitapaawo ipankosheta janta.
ari rowetsikaki taapokimentotsi, iitakiro El-Eloje-Israel.

footnotes.text: 33.17 Iroka waerontsi “Sucot,” iñaaniki riroripaeni oshiyawitawo akantziri aaka “pankosheta.”
33.20 Iroka waerontsi “El-Eloje-Israel,” iñaaniki riroripaeni oshiyawitakawo akantziri aaka “Tajorentsi riitaki Itajorentsite Israel.”
